items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: He served several, like a few lessons, I'd go to the house like on Sundays with the kids, and we'd go over some music and stuff like that. Yeah, he taught me a little, you know.

ctx.x: I guess he used to teach music quite a bit, I remember. Yeah, he did. He never took any lessons, though, from him.

He served several, like a few lessons, I'd go to the house like on Sundays with the kids, and we'd go over some music and stuff like that. Yeah, he taught me a little, you know. Yes, I understand. Yeah, yeah, I know him very well. The family, rather.

I wondered about some of the clarinet players that you've played with. Who would be your favorite clarinet players in the old days, especially the older men that you remember when you were a boy? I like Pico.
